settable_by.flag: fractal-wallpapers render --<flag>; a mode parameter is --param NAME=VALUE
settable_by.spec: only through a spec JSON: fractal-engine render <spec.json>, whose keys are FORMATS.md's *The render spec*

phoenix_m.note: the Phoenix parameter plane: the pixel is c

fractional_multibrot.note: render only, with no home view: center_re, center_im and width are required

maxiter.range: an integer, >= 1 (an explorer link holds it to 50-2,000,000)
maxiter.unsaid: the depth policy's cap for the view's width

modes.name: smooth
modes.identity: Fractional escape time: the spine every composite builds on.

modes.name: tia
modes.identity: Triangle-inequality average: fine engraved banding.

modes.name: stripe
modes.identity: Stripe average at density 6: combed flowing striations.

modes.name: exp_smoothing
modes.identity: Sum of exp(-|z|) over the orbit: an averaging alternative to smooth.

modes.name: gaussian_int
modes.identity: Closest approach to the integer lattice: a tiled, beaded field.

modes.name: trap_circle
modes.identity: Closest approach to the unit circle, read through a log curve.

modes.name: curvature
modes.identity: Mean turning angle of the orbit.

modes.name: smooth_mean_angle
modes.identity: Smooth base, screened with the lattice trap's spread angle.

modes.name: smooth_angle_min
modes.identity: Smooth base, screened with the angle at the lattice's closest approach.

modes.name: smooth_trap_circle
modes.identity: Smooth base, screened with the circle trap: structure in the interior.

modes.name: smooth_stripe
modes.identity: Smooth base, screened with the stripe average.

modes.name: smooth_curvature
modes.identity: Smooth base, screened with curvature.

modes.name: direct_trap_ring
modes.identity: Direct trap, ring shape, screened over black: the cleanest of the family.

modes.name: direct_trap_screen
modes.identity: Direct trap, cross shape, screened over black: bright thorns.

modes.name: direct_trap_multiply
modes.identity: Direct trap, cross shape, multiplied over white: dark lace on light.

modes.name: direct_trap_lines
modes.identity: Direct trap on the real axis: the narrowest, most directional member.

modes.name: threads
modes.identity: Smooth base plus the accumulated cross trap: sparse organic flow.

modes.name: itinerary
modes.identity: Smooth base whose palette position the orbit's angular address shifts. The address opens at z1 on a dynamical plane and at z0 on a parameter one.

modes.name: tail_itinerary
modes.identity: Smooth base shifted by the LAST symbols of the orbit's angular address, rather than the first. Reads the same on both planes.

modes.name: de
modes.identity: Distance to the set itself, read through a log curve. No lighting.

cycles.says: times the map repeats over the field

phase.says: turns the map is rotated by

mirror.says: fold the map out and back; refused on a cyclic map (`palettes list --kind`)

transfer.range: value (default), edge:W with W >= 0, or rank
transfer.says: what the map is indexed by

rolloff.range: none (default), soft_knee:K with K in [0, 1), reinhard, or aces
rolloff.says: how the brightest values are compressed

scale.says: leveled (default) spreads the map over the field's own range; absolute indexes it by the raw count, where --period and --knee apply and gamma, cycles and transfer do not

spec_only.curve: linear, sqrt, log or scurve: an explicit coloring's `transform`
spec_only.coloring: a full coloring object in place of a named mode
spec_only.colormap_dir: where the colormap files are (default data/palettes)
spec_only.allow_unresolvable_in_f64: allow a frame too deep for f64 to resolve (default false)

a mode parameter, repeatable: density (stripe, smooth_stripe), radius (trap_circle, smooth_trap_circle, direct traps), sigma (threads), weight (the smooth_* composites and threads, in [0, 1]), shift (itinerary, tail_itinerary), threshold and opacity (direct_trap_*). `modes` lists the modes
a location record to render instead of spelling one out: the {family, viewport, render} object a ledger row, a label row and a release record all already carry

a JSONL of location records to render, one picture per row, into --out-dir — a label row, a ledger candidate carrying its cap flat, a release decision row and a hand-written {family, viewport, maxiter, mode, colormap} all read. The coloring goes nested under `render` or flat beside `family`, whichever the writer prefers, because this repository's own records are written both ways. A row that spells one member both ways and disagrees with itself is refused, and so is a row carrying a whole picture — a curve, a palette pass, a mode's own settings — which belongs at --recipe FILE, because a location record is a place and a geometry and drawing one of those would be the right coordinates in the wrong picture. A file rather than a list of paths, because a batch is hundreds of rows and a Windows command line is not

a stored RECIPE — everything the picture is a function of, not only the place. A published record's `recipes.jsonl` (one {key, recipe} row per seat, name one with --key) or a single recipe block copied out of one. The difference from --location is the curve, the palette block, the mode's settings and the levelling band, none of which a location record carries — so a seat drawn through --location is the right coordinates in the wrong colours. The levelling is re-derived the way the candidate path derived it, and the band the recipe names is checked against this checkout's before anything is drawn
which recipe of a --recipe file to draw: a seat's full key or any unique prefix of one, so the eight-character alias a record prints works
output PNG path (default: artifacts/render.png)
where a --manifest run's pictures go (default: artifacts/renders). Each is named by its row and a digest of its own recipe, and renders.jsonl beside them is the join back to the records
render only the first N rows of a manifest
skip a row whose picture is already on disk
